Risk Title & Description: Automated Bot Order Spam on Public Checkout Endpoint
Current Compensating Controls: Firestore rules enforce strict schema validation (orderNumber, customerName, items list); client-side double-click locking via isProcessingRef.
Recommended Long-Term Action: Implement Firebase App Check with reCAPTCHA Enterprise on Firebase project to verify genuine client origin.

Risk Title & Description: Administrative Authorization Reliant on Firestore Document Reads
Current Compensating Controls: Rules strictly check /databases/$(database)/documents/admins/$(request.auth.uid).isActive == true; arbitrary writes to /admins blocked.
Recommended Long-Term Action: Migrate administrative privileges to Firebase Auth Custom Claims (token.admin == true) set via secure Cloud Function.

Risk Title & Description: Transactional Email Delivery via Google Apps Script Webhook
Current Compensating Controls: AbortController with 10s timeout prevents checkout thread lock; non-blocking background dispatch ensures order is secured in Firestore even if email delays.
Recommended Long-Term Action: Transition from Google Apps Script to authenticated enterprise transactional email API (SendGrid, Resend, or AWS SES).

Recommended Long-Term Action: Plan architectural migration from react-scripts to Vite 5+ with React 18/19 for faster builds, ESM modules, and future React features.

Risk Title & Description: High-Density Mobile Device Viewport Density Image Sizing
Current Compensating Controls: All images compressed by 81.1%; max single image file size under 800kB; catalog images use loading='lazy' and decoding='async'.
Recommended Long-Term Action: Implement dynamic responsive srcset and WebP/AVIF picture elements for adaptive viewport delivery on 2G/3G connections.

Risk Title & Description: Degraded Mobile Network Handling During Order Placement
Current Compensating Controls: Blocking Firestore write prevents silent order loss; error banner displayed; cart items preserved in localStorage for instant retry.
Recommended Long-Term Action: Implement offline order queuing in IndexedDB with background service worker synchronization when connection is re-established.

Risk Title & Description: Search Engine Crawler Discovery of Newly Published Catalog Products
Current Compensating Controls: public/sitemap.xml catalogs all canonical routes; public/robots.txt references sitemap; Vercel rewrites bypass static XML assets.
Recommended Long-Term Action: Submit sitemap.xml to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools upon production deployment to expedite indexation.

Risk Title & Description: Absence of Centralized Error Tracking in Production
Current Compensating Controls: React Error Boundary components wrap public routes and administrative dashboards; detailed console logs maintained.
Recommended Long-Term Action: Integrate Sentry or LogRocket client-side error monitoring to capture unhandled runtime exceptions in real time.
